about_the_game:
Four-player game using the Tien gow Tile, called "Playing Tien gow".
It is known as a traditional game in the Chinese-speaking world, where players can enjoy the game of luck and tactics "like a millionaire's game" and "like poker.

To make it easier to play, "Japanese Style Tien Gow" is now available, with rules unique to Japan!

Simple rule explanation

.Each player is dealt 8 tiles, and all 4 players take turns to play a tile, counterclockwise starting from the player with the highest tile.
The player with the strongest tile wins the right to play the next tile first, and so on until there are no more tiles left.
The player with the strongest tile when the last tile is played wins! This is how the game is played.

It sounds simple when written like this, but there are some rules, such as a maximum of four tiles can be played at the same time, and there is a tile that is the strongest combination.

"It looks difficult ......" you may think, but don't worry!
The game is equipped with an extensive tutorial that covers how to play the game and even basic strategy, with explanations as you play.
Even if you know nothing about the game, you will be able to play while understanding the rules in turn.

The game also has a tile strength guide function that allows you to check the strength of the tiles at any time during play!
Even if you find yourself thinking, "I don't know if the tile I'm playing is strong or weak! you can check the strength of the tiles by checking the tile strength guide.

In the demo version, you will be able to enjoy a part of the tutorial, predefined selection rules and predefined NPCs to play against.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: (Intel processor) High Sierra 10.13 or higher, (Apple processor) Big Sur 11.0 or higher
  • Processor: (Intel processor) X64 architecture supporting SSE2 instruction set, (Apple processor) Apple M1 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-enabled Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

  • OS: windows 10 and above

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10 (shader model 4.0) capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

short_description: "Japanese Style Tien gow" is a game exclusively for four players using 32 tiles. Tiles are played based on the 8 tiles dealt, and the last player to play a strong tile wins. In the demo version, you can enjoy a part of the tutorial and play against NPCs.
